title: Old Faithful
subtitle: 改寫自美國國家公園管理局：黃石公園最守時的間歇泉

source.name: National Park Service, Yellowstone National Park
source.title: Old Faithful Geyser
source.basis: Work of the U.S. federal government (National Park Service), 17 U.S.C. §105; retold only from the NPS's own text, not from credited photos or partner content.

sentences.en: Old Faithful is probably the best-known geyser in Yellowstone National Park.
sentences.zh: 老忠實泉大概是黃石國家公園裡最有名的間歇泉。

highlights.note: national park 國家公園；美國的國家公園由聯邦政府管理。

examples.en: The geyser shoots water into the air.
examples.zh: 間歇泉把水噴向空中。

examples.en: Taipei 101 is the city's best-known building.
examples.zh: 台北 101 是這座城市最有名的建築。

sentences.en: A geyser is a hot spring that shoots water and steam high into the air from time to time.
sentences.zh: 間歇泉是一種溫泉，會不時把水和蒸氣高高噴向空中。

examples.en: We visited a hot spring in Beitou.
examples.zh: 我們去了北投的溫泉。

examples.en: I still visit my old school from time to time.
examples.zh: 我偶爾還會回母校看看。

grammar.quote: a hot spring that shoots water
grammar.explanation: that 引導限定關係子句，說明是「哪一種」溫泉。

examples.en: A dictionary is a book that explains words.
examples.zh: 字典是解釋字詞的書。

grammar.pitfall: that 子句的動詞要跟 a hot spring 一致，用單數 shoots。

sentences.en: Old Faithful erupts more often than any of the other big geysers in the park.
sentences.zh: 老忠實泉噴發的頻率，比園區內其他任何大型間歇泉都高。

examples.en: The volcano erupted last year.
examples.zh: 那座火山去年噴發了。

grammar.point: comparative + than any of the other
grammar.quote: more often than any of the other big geysers
grammar.explanation: 比較級 + than any of the other + 複數名詞，等於最高級的意思。

examples.en: She runs faster than any of the other girls.
examples.zh: 她跑得比其他女生都快。

grammar.pitfall: 要加 other，否則就把自己也比進去了。

sentences.en: Interestingly, it is not the largest geyser there, and it is not the most regular one either.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，它並不是那裡最大的間歇泉，也不是最規律的。

examples.en: Regular exercise keeps you healthy.
examples.zh: 規律運動讓你保持健康。

grammar.quote: it is not the most regular one either
grammar.explanation: 否定句的「也不」用 either 放句尾；肯定句才用 too。

examples.en: I don't like coffee, and my sister doesn't either.
examples.zh: 我不喜歡咖啡，我姊姊也不喜歡。

grammar.pitfall: 不要在否定句用 too：it is not regular too 是錯的。

connected.note: 美式 t 在母音間彈舌，聽起來像 d。

sentences.en: On average, visitors wait about ninety minutes between eruptions.
sentences.zh: 平均來說，遊客每兩次噴發之間大約要等 90 分鐘。

examples.en: On average, I sleep seven hours a night.
examples.zh: 我平均每晚睡七小時。

examples.en: The eruption lasted three days.
examples.zh: 這次噴發持續了三天。

sentences.en: Sometimes the wait is as short as fifty minutes, and sometimes it is more than two hours.
sentences.zh: 有時只要等 50 分鐘，有時則要超過兩個小時。

examples.en: The food was worth the wait.
examples.zh: 這些食物值得等。

grammar.explanation: as + 形容詞 + as + 數字，強調數字之小（或大），例如 as short as、as much as。

examples.en: Tickets cost as little as 100 dollars.
examples.zh: 票價最低只要 100 元。

grammar.pitfall: 聽力時注意 fifty 和 fifteen 的重音：FIF-ty 重音在前，fif-TEEN 重音在後。

sentences.en: Each eruption lasts between one and a half and five minutes.
sentences.zh: 每次噴發持續 1 分半到 5 分鐘。

highlights.text: between one and a half and five minutes
highlights.note: between A and B；A 本身是 one and a half，所以出現兩個 and，要聽清楚斷句。

examples.en: The meeting lasted two hours.
examples.zh: 會議持續了兩個小時。

sentences.en: During that time, the geyser throws out thousands of gallons of boiling water.
sentences.zh: 在這段時間裡，間歇泉會噴出數千加侖的滾燙熱水。

examples.en: We bought a gallon of water for the trip.
examples.zh: 我們為這趟旅行買了一加侖的水。

examples.en: The fire threw out a lot of smoke.
examples.zh: 火冒出大量的煙。

connected.note: thousands 的 s 和 of 連讀，of 弱讀。

sentences.en: The water can shoot more than fifty meters into the sky.
sentences.zh: 水柱可以衝上 50 多公尺的高空。

examples.en: Fireworks shot into the night sky.
examples.zh: 煙火衝上夜空。

examples.en: More than half of the students passed.
examples.zh: 超過一半的學生及格了。

sentences.en: The geyser got its name in 1870, from members of the Washburn expedition.
sentences.zh: 這座間歇泉在 1870 年，由沃什本探險隊的成員命名。

examples.en: They joined an expedition to the South Pole.
examples.zh: 他們加入了前往南極的探險隊。

grammar.explanation: 四位數年份要兩位兩位念：1870 念成 eighteen seventy。

examples.en: My grandfather was born in 1948.
examples.zh: 我爺爺生於 1948 年（念作 nineteen forty-eight）。

grammar.pitfall: 不要念成 one thousand eight hundred seventy。

sentences.en: They called it Old Faithful because it kept erupting again and again, as if it were keeping a promise.
sentences.zh: 他們叫它「老忠實」，因為它一次又一次地噴發，彷彿在信守承諾。

examples.en: My dog is a faithful friend.
examples.zh: 我的狗是忠實的朋友。

grammar.quote: as if it were keeping a promise
grammar.explanation: as if 後面用假設語氣（were），表示「好像…一樣」，其實不是真的。

examples.en: He talks as if he were the boss.
examples.zh: 他說話的樣子好像他是老闆。

grammar.pitfall: 正式用法 as if 後面的 be 動詞用 were，不用 was。

connected.note: kept 的 t 和 erupting 連讀。

sentences.en: Today, the buildings around it are all kept about two hundred meters away, as required by federal law.
sentences.zh: 如今，周圍的建築物都依照聯邦法律的規定，和它保持大約 200 公尺的距離。

examples.en: Federal law protects national parks.
examples.zh: 聯邦法律保護國家公園。

examples.en: Wear a helmet, as required by law.
examples.zh: 依法規定要戴安全帽。

grammar.quote: are all kept about two hundred meters away
grammar.explanation: keep + 受詞 + 補語的被動式：建築物被保持在一定距離外。

examples.en: The doors are kept locked at night.
examples.zh: 門在晚上都保持上鎖。

grammar.pitfall: all 放在 be 動詞後面：are all kept，不要寫成 all are kept 後再加主詞。

chunks.text: are all kept about two hundred meters away,
chunks.zh: 都保持大約 200 公尺的距離

sentences.en: If you visit, always stay on the boardwalks and marked trails.
sentences.zh: 如果你去參觀，一定要待在木棧道和標示的步道上。

examples.en: We walked along the boardwalk by the river.
examples.zh: 我們沿著河邊的木棧道散步。

examples.en: This trail leads to a waterfall.
examples.zh: 這條步道通往一座瀑布。

sentences.en: The water in hydrothermal areas is hot enough to burn you badly.
sentences.zh: 地熱區的水溫高到足以把你嚴重燙傷。

examples.en: Yellowstone has many hydrothermal features.
examples.zh: 黃石公園有許多地熱景觀。

examples.en: Be careful not to burn your hand.
examples.zh: 小心不要燙到手。

grammar.explanation: 形容詞 + enough + to V，表示「足以…」；enough 放在形容詞後面。

examples.en: He is old enough to drive.
examples.zh: 他已經到了可以開車的年紀。

grammar.pitfall: 不要寫成 enough hot，enough 修飾形容詞時放在後面。

sentences.en: Keep children close, and remember that you are responsible for your own safety.
sentences.zh: 讓孩子待在身邊，並記住你要為自己的安全負責。

examples.en: Each student is responsible for cleaning the classroom.
examples.zh: 每位學生都要負責打掃教室。

examples.en: Keep your bag close on the MRT.
examples.zh: 搭捷運時包包要放在身邊。

connected.note: for 在句中弱讀成 fər。
